title.value: Tell, Draw, and Repeat: Generating and Modifying Images Based on Continual Linguistic Instruction
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the article, right after the list of authors and their affiliations.
title.quote: Tell, Draw, and Repeat: Generating and Modifying Images Based on Continual Linguistic Instruction

analysis.description: This paper presents a model for generating and modifying images based on continual linguistic instruction. It introduces a new task called Generative Neural Visual Artist (GeNeVA), which involves iterative image generation based on linguistic instructions. The paper also introduces a recurrent GAN architecture for this task and evaluates its performance using synthetic datasets, namely CoDraw and i-CLEVR.

type.justification: The paper involves developing a model and evaluating its performance on datasets, which characterizes empirical research.
type.quote: Our experiments on the CoDraw and i-CLEVR datasets show that our model is capable of generating images that incrementally build upon the previously generated images and follow the provided instructions.
